title: SD-Cache: Learnable Memory Consolidation with State-Guided Dynamic Caching
abstract: arXiv:2611.31265v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as persistent services that must reason over large volumes of external knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds model responses in relevant documents, but the retrieved content must still be encoded and stored in the key-value (KV) cache. As this content accumulates, the cache grows linearly, increasing memory consumption and inference cost. Existing memory-compression methods address this problem either by retaining a subset of cached states or by learning context compressors that map documents to compact latent representations. Despite these advances, consolidating information under tight memory budgets while preserving its usefulness for future queries remains challenging. translated_title: SD-Cache：基于状态引导动态缓存的可学习记忆整合
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为需要对海量外部知识进行推理的持久化服务。检索增强生成（RAG）虽然将模型响应建立在相关文档的基础上，但检索到的内容仍需被编码并存储在键值（KV）缓存中。随着这些内容不断积累，缓存呈线性增长，导致内存消耗和推理成本上升。现有的记忆压缩方法要么通过保留缓存状态的一个子集来解决该问题，要么通过学习将文档映射为紧凑潜在表示的上下文压缩器。尽管取得了这些进展，如何在紧张的内存预算下整合信息、同时保持其对未来查询的有用性，仍然是一个挑战。我们研究了如何在无法访问未来查询的情况下，将模型原生的KV状态选择性地整合到一个固定大小的工作记忆中。为此，我们提出了SD-Cache（状态引导……）
tldr: 提出SD-Cache，通过状态引导的动态缓存机制，在不预知未来查询的情况下，将LLM原生的KV状态选择性地整合到固定大小的工作记忆中，解决了RAG场景下KV缓存线性增长的问题。
en_tdlr: SD-Cache enables learnable memory consolidation via state-guided dynamic caching, selectively consolidating a model's native KV states into a fixed-size working memory without access to future queries, tackling the linear growth of KV caches in RAG deployments.
